description: Jazzer-driven byte[] fuzz against eu.exeris.kernel.core.http.http1.Http1RequestParser (parseRequestLine + parseHeaders). Each fuzz iteration wraps the mutated byte[] in a confined Arena MemorySegment and invokes the parser. Whitelisted throwables (Http1ParseException, IndexOutOfBoundsException, IllegalArgumentException, BufferUnderflowException) are recorded but do NOT count as findings. Any other Throwable (NPE, AssertionError, OOM, StackOverflow, VirtualMachineError) is a finding.
comparison_axis_note: Fuzz findings are exploratory by construction. Do NOT report iterations/sec as a perf claim — Jazzer's internal coverage feedback makes throughput non-stationary. The relevant axes are robustness (zero unexpected crashes) and Arena leak count delta.
publication_mode_reason: Crash inputs produced by Jazzer (crash-<sha1>) contain attacker-supplied bytes; basename blocklist in publish-report.sh blocks them outside internal-only mode.
